# Vendored dependency

`qrcode.mjs` comes from `qrcode-generator` 2.0.4 by Kazuhiko Arase:

- source: https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/qrcode-generator/v/2.0.4
- license: MIT

The upstream copyright and MIT notice remain at the top of the vendored file. It is bundled locally so an
unpacked Edge extension can render the one-time pairing QR without a network request or build-time download.
